title: tests/userspace/test_luks.sh: LUKS full-disk encryption roundtrip
description: Shell script testing LUKS (Linux Unified Key Setup) end-to-end with wolfkm as the crypto provider. Steps: create a LUKS2 volume on a loopback device, open it, create ext4, mount, write 100MB of random data, record checksums, unmount, close LUKS, reopen, remount, verify checksums. Tests that dm-crypt's key derivation and block encryption go through wolfkm. Requires cryptsetup, root.
design: cryptsetup luksFormat --type luks2 --cipher aes-xts-plain64 --hash sha256 --iter-time 100 (fast for testing). Use a known passphrase. cryptsetup luksOpen / luksClose. Check /proc/crypto during operation to confirm wolfkm-xts-aes is in use. See DESIGN.md §test_luks.
acceptance_criteria: LUKS volume opens and closes correctly. Data checksums match after reopen. /proc/crypto confirms wolfkm as provider. Script is idempotent and cleans up on failure.
